// Leak (b): FORGE A Perturbed COMPOSITE LITERAL CARRYING ANOTHER CLASS'S TICKET.
//
// A composite literal goes around NewPerturbed, and with it around the stripe assertion, the
// marker check and the vault's record of who owns what. The old shape kept an owner field on the
// value, so a forger could write owner: ClassSQL over somebody else's observation and the
// accessor, which compared against that same field, agreed.
//
// The field names are unexported, so from another package there is nothing to write.
package leakfixture

import "ars0n-framework-v2-server/utils/triage"

func leakForgedLiteral(victim triage.Perturbed) triage.Perturbed {
	return triage.Perturbed{vault: victim.vault, ticket: victim.ticket}
}
